notes: K2: each item at each shop counted once per visit; repeat visits to the same shop on different occasions (New Maadi stand shop Thu 14:18, Thu 15:31 bulk ask, Sun 14:15) counted separately because outcomes differed. Alternatives in one request (e.g. adhesive pieces/Velcro/shoelace) counted as one item. The 131 EGP stand counted as too dear because Seb rejected it on price right after. Two Bostan Mall searches with no named shop left unclear. K3: one item per shop; Abbasiya electrician 2 counted true because it offered same-day joining after 17:12 (no test, no module supplied). Silent, busy or unanswered remote asks left unclear. Fares counted false for K3 (refused in person) and true for K1 (phone claim proved wrong). K7: both Fares phone answers counted as usable firm yes on a service, since Seb sent B there on them; Metanoia replies counted false because they gave no quote and only 'cannot confirm'. K4: no time-bound ready promise was ever made on a placed job. K5: no technician-made head existed; the delivered lamp was a factory USB strip on a phone stand. K6: quoted_min measured from booking to the app arrival estimate (pickup wait included where the app gave one). B's Thursday Lampatronics ride was rerouted mid-trip and B's final Sunday ride has conflicting arrival times (chat 18:00 vs log 18:30:30), so both left unclear.
